retrieval_scope: Publisher RSS content:encoded bodies, distinguished from direct article HTML and web reader output. One previously successful article supplied by an advertised JSON alternate proves that surface, without increasing unique body coverage. The two complete web reader prose reads match original challenged article URLs but are reported separately and do not increase the direct archive body count.
gaps: The remaining 2410 original URLs retain their original HTTP202 challenge evidence. They were not retried.
Forty nine newly declared feed endpoints returned HTTP202 and were not retried. The previously challenged combined feed was skipped.

Ordinary page2 feed requests, documented maximum page size JSON collections and three linked editorial indexes returned HTTP202. No headers, cookies, identity, URL parameter variations or challenge execution were used to get around those results.
The three accessible feeds contain recent snapshots without declared next cursors. Consuming them does not prove historical exhaustion.
The public JSON API index and one advertised single item are accessible, but no accessible paginated collection supplies older missing item identifiers. IDs were not guessed or enumerated.
The intermediate feed index has a retained OPML receipt field bug; the additive binding correction verifies the actual OPML source and complete endpoint dispositions.
No complete archive export, authenticated publisher access, production performance or runtime guarantee is established.
Administrative, plugin, translation management and mutation API routes were not exercised. Their presence in an API route index does not establish an ordinary public publication archive.
